commit.message:
fix(readme): restore preserved-but-lost content and fix internal-tooling leak (#1)

fix(readme): restore preserved-but-lost content and fix internal-tooling leak

- Remove 3 internal build-reporting classes (TaskTokenEstimate,
  TaskCompletionReceipt, CompletedTaskRecord) that were incorrectly listed
  in the public API Reference table -- these back a separate internal
  console script (aspose-font-reporting) and are not part of the public
  font-processing API.
- Restore CLI coverage for the general inspection/conversion and QA-tooling
  command categories, plus the var-instance subcommand, matching the
  breadth of CLI usage already documented in the original project README.
- Add verified, runnable examples for five capabilities that were present
  in the original README but had no working equivalent in this candidate:
  font subsetting, preview-naming-policy control, live vs. static
  variable-font export, menu-safe naming overrides, and the grid-family
  package workflow.
- No other section of the README was changed.

Verification:
- Every added API call and CLI invocation independently verified against
  the current source at commit 136b6e20c3916ac4c8efac0714948a4136b491a3.
- Full deterministic check battery (92 checks) re-run against the final
  candidate: 0 hard-gate failures.
- Section-isolation confirmed: only the API Reference and Additional
  Examples sections changed; every other section is byte-identical to the
  prior candidate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
